Questions

Anything else, email me at r.halabitskyi@gmail.com.

Is the sample really free?

Yes. No card details and no contract. If you don't like it, you don't owe me anything.

What do I need to send you?

Just your business name and where you work. I build the sample from what's already online about you, like your reviews and photos of your jobs. You can send me better photos later.

I already have a website. Can you redo it?

Yes. Andrew's Auto Repairs had a site from 2017, and the new version is the one on the laptop at the top of this page.

Will it work on phones?

Every site is built for phones first, then checked on tablets and laptops before you see it.

Who will I be dealing with?

Me, Roman. I'm based in Manchester and study Digital Business and Technology Innovation at Manchester Metropolitan University. You deal with me from the first message until your site is live.

Are there any other costs?

The £119 is paid once for building the site. If anything else costs money, like your own web address, I'll tell you before you pay.
